SELECT R.REPORT_NO AS reportId, R.REPORT_TYPE AS reportType, R.REPORTEE_NO AS targetId, U.NICKNAME AS targetNickname, R.USER_NO AS reporterId, R.REPORT_REASON AS reason, RD.STATE AS status, DATE_FORMAT(R.REPORT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt
FROM REPORT R
LEFT JOIN USER U ON R.REPORTEE_NO = U.USER_NO
LEFT JOIN REPORT_DETAIL RD ON R.REPORT_NO = RD.REPORT_NO
ORDER BY R.REPORT_DATE DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.BOARD_TITLE AS title, U.NICKNAME AS author, B.LIKES_COUNT AS likeCount, B.TYPE_NO AS typeNo FROM BOARD B JOIN USER U ON B.USER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_DELETE = 'N' ORDER BY B.LIKES_COUNT DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT I.INQUIRY_NO AS inquiryId, I.USER_NO AS userNo, I.INQUIRY_TITLE AS title, I.INQUIRY_CONTENT AS content, I.TYPE_NAME AS typeName, U.NICKNAME AS writer, U.USER_EMAIL AS email, I.INQUIRY_STATUS AS status, DATE_FORMAT(I.INQUIRY_POSTDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt, I.ANSWER AS answer, DATE_FORMAT(I.ANSWER_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS answerDate
FROM INQUIRY I LEFT JOIN USER U ON I.USER_NO = U.USER_NO
WHERE I.INQUIRY_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY I.INQUIRY_POSTDATE ASC LIMIT 5

%H:%i') AS createdAt, CASE WHEN R.REPORT_TYPE LIKE '%댓글%' THEN 'COMMENT' ELSE 'BOARD' END AS targetKind, CASE WHEN R.REPORT_TYPE LIKE '%댓글%' THEN ( SELECT C.COMMENT_NO FROM COMMENT C WHERE C.USER_NO = B.BOARD_POSTDATE <= R.REPORT_DATE ORDER BY B.BOARD_POSTDATE DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC LIMIT 1 ) END AS targetContentId, CASE WHEN R.REPORT_TYPE LIKE '%댓글%' THEN ( SELECT B.BOARD_TITLE FROM COMMENT C JOIN FROM BOARD B WHERE B.USER_NO = R.REPORTEE_NO AND B.BOARD_POSTDATE <= R.REPORT_DATE ORDER BY B.BOARD_POSTDATE DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC LIMIT 1 ) END AS targetTitle, CASE WHEN R.REPORT_TYPE LIKE '%댓글%' B.BOARD_TITLE FROM BOARD B WHERE B.USER_NO = R.REPORTEE_NO AND B.BOARD_POSTDATE <= R.REPORT_DATE ORDER BY B.BOARD_POSTDATE DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC LIMIT 1 ) END AS targetContent, CASE WHEN RD.STATE = 'C' THEN '처리 완료' WHEN RD.STATE = 'R' THEN '반려' ELSE NULL END AS processAction FROM REPORT R LEFT JOIN REPORT_DETAIL RD ON R.REPORT_NO = RD.REPORT_NO LEFT JOIN USER REPORTER ON R.USER_NO =
